parameters.name: GatewayRoute
parameters.description: The information about the gateway route.

parameters.name: IstioGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The route priority. The value is an integer. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the ASM instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the gateway route. Valid values:

- `0`: The gateway route is in service.

- `1`: The gateway route is unpublished.

- `2`: An error occurred when the gateway route was created or updated.
